title: Refine: redraw a selection lightly
description: A canvas action: select an area of a canvas and it is redrawn lightly (FLUX.2 Klein 4B, 4 steps, strength 0.7), keeping its shapes and colours, and added as a new layer with a soft-edged mask. The task bar's Advanced popover offers Strength as Light (0.55), Default (0.7) or Restyle (0.9); a prompt says what to change. The Canvas view's task bar lists it; open it here to edit the workflow.
